Evidence: (1) direct grep of receipts.edn shows only lines 255 and 259 of the five new 2026-10-07 records contain `:repo` — lines 256-258 do not; (2) law/receipt.cljs:16-17 lists `:repo` in `legacy-required-keys` and :147-151 routes unwrapped maps through `legacy-errors`, whose `missing-errors` reports "missing required key: repo"; (3) the consumer chain is live — receipt-river CLI `validate` (infra/cli.cljs:68) calls api/validate-line (api.cljs:17-20) which applies `law/record-errors` per line; (4) the PR's own adjudication at line 259 concedes the originals "do not pass that validator," because corrections are not folded — the appended correction does not restore compliance. Smallest corrective direction: before merge (these records are not yet immutable main history), add `:repo "open-hax/eta-mu"` to lines 256-258 so all five appended records pass `record-errors`; alternatively follow the #293 resolution (fresh corrected records) if byte preservation of committed branch commits is required, and record any owner-authorized exception in the PR description rather than only inside the ledger itself.

(require '[cljs.reader :as edn] '[clojure.string :as str] '[eta-mu.receipt-river.law.receipt :as law] '["node:fs" :as fs] '["node:crypto" :as crypto])
(def root "/home/err/spaces/cephalon-review-receiver/receiver-plan")
(def proof ".ημ/review-evidence/receiver-receipt-corrected-copies-20261008.json")
(def data (.readFileSync fs (str root "/receipts.edn")))
(def lines (str/split (.toString data "utf8") #"\n"))
(def recorded-at (.toISOString (js/Date.)))
(defn sha [s] (.digest (.update (.createHash crypto "sha256") s) "hex"))
(def sources (mapv (fn [n] (let [raw (str (nth lines (dec n)) "\n")] {:ordinal n :raw-bytes (.byteLength js/Buffer raw "utf8") :raw-sha256 (sha raw) :record (edn/read-string raw)})) [256 257 258]))
(def adjudication (edn/read-string (nth lines 258)))
(assert (= "open-hax/eta-mu" (:repo adjudication)))
(assert (= "receiver-receipt-repo-append-only-correction-20261007" (:origin adjudication)))
(assert (every? #(= ["missing required key: repo"] (law/record-errors (:record %))) sources))
(assert (empty? (law/record-errors adjudication)))
(def corrections
 (mapv (fn [{:keys [ordinal raw-sha256 raw-bytes record]}]
  (-> record
   (assoc :repo (:repo adjudication) :ts recorded-at)
   (update :refs into
    [(str "Appended corrected copy; source-path:receipts.edn;source-ordinal:" ordinal ";ordinal-scope:1-based physical EDN line")
     (str "source-raw-sha256:" raw-sha256 ";source-raw-bytes:" raw-bytes ";hash-scope:exact UTF-8 line including final LF")
     "source-head:1c4c53a8af725322d9b6d508d4d165a3dc979685;source-repository:riatzukiza/eta-mu;owning-repository:open-hax/eta-mu"
     (str "source-ts:" (:ts record) ";source-origin:" (:origin record) ";correction-recorded-at:" recorded-at)
     "Attribution adjudication:receipts.edn;source-ordinal:259;source-raw-sha256:971476edb88417a5037b8d09cae9447fb1391d5b691007cbb014f77b8802f3ed"
     "Native offered alternative:riatzukiza/eta-mu#8;MiMo root4212734252@1c4c53a8af725322d9b6d508d4d165a3dc979685;fresh corrected records;owner-authorized append-only exception description remains parent-owned"
     (str "Bounded correction verification:" proof)])
   (update :note str
    (str " APPENDED CORRECTED COPY recorded " recorded-at ": repository metadata supplied from ordinal259 while preserving original ordinal" ordinal " and its exact raw line hash. The source timestamp " (:ts record) " is historical event provenance; this receipt's :ts records the correction. All original event claims, tests, decisions, manifest paths, owner and origin above are historical copied evidence, not fresh execution or current approval. The original rows remain unchanged and still fail record-errors for missing :repo. This append defines no consumer folding, validation waiver, native approval or settlement; parent owns Git/GitHub publication and any description exception.")))) sources))
(doseq [[source corrected] (map vector sources corrections)]
 (let [original (:record source)]
  (assert (= (dissoc original :ts :repo :refs :note) (dissoc corrected :ts :repo :refs :note)))
  (assert (= (:refs original) (subvec (:refs corrected) 0 (count (:refs original)))))
  (assert (str/starts-with? (:note corrected) (:note original)))
  (assert (empty? (law/record-errors corrected)))))
(def suffix (apply str (map #(str (pr-str %) "\n") corrections)))
(assert (= corrections (mapv edn/read-string (remove str/blank? (str/split suffix #"\n")))))
(def result {:recorded_at recorded-at :proof_path proof :candidate_edn suffix :candidate_bytes (.byteLength js/Buffer suffix "utf8") :candidate_sha256 (sha suffix) :adjudication_errors (law/record-errors adjudication) :sources (mapv (fn [s] (-> (dissoc s :record) (assoc :original_ts (:ts (:record s)) :original_kind (str (:kind (:record s))) :original_origin (:origin (:record s)) :errors (law/record-errors (:record s))))) sources) :new_errors (mapv law/record-errors corrections) :original_nonmetadata_fields_equal true :original_refs_prefix_equal true :original_note_prefix_equal true :roundtrip_equal true})
(println (js/JSON.stringify (clj->js result)))
